_readme: Scene composition definitions for programmatic image prompt assembly (js/logic/prompts.js).
Strict adult-only phrasing: every person tag explicitly specifies adult.
clientPhrase: an anonymous well-dressed adult male patron in shadow
directorPhrase: a commanding adult male academy director in a tailored dark suit

portrait.label: Academy Portrait
portrait.setting: gothic stone academy courtyard at dusk, wrought-iron lanterns, dramatic architectural shadows
portrait.pose: confident upper-body portrait framing, looking toward the viewer

class_Academics.label: Morning Lecture
class_Academics.setting: grand wood-paneled academy lecture hall, tall arched windows, leather-bound books on desk
class_Academics.pose: sitting gracefully at a polished oak desk with open notebooks

class_PE.label: Athletic Center
class_PE.setting: sleek private academy gymnasium with polished timber floors and moody skylight
class_PE.pose: stretching gracefully after conditioning drills, faint sheen of sweat

class_Performance.label: Stage Rehearsal
class_Performance.setting: velvet-draped rehearsal studio with tall mirrors and warm stage spotlights
class_Performance.pose: mid-rehearsal poise beneath a golden spotlight

class_Seduction.label: Beauty Salon
class_Seduction.setting: opulent velvet salon lounge with gilded mirrors, perfume bottles, and amber lamps
class_Seduction.pose: reclining on a velvet settee, practicing an alluring gaze

class_Intimacy.label: Intimacy Practicum
class_Intimacy.setting: candlelit private academy chamber with crimson curtains and silk cushions
class_Intimacy.pose: kneeling gracefully on velvet cushions, poised and attentive

class_Service.label: Service Practicum
class_Service.setting: upscale private training suite with warm brass sconces and mahogany counter
class_Service.pose: standing attentively beside a low velvet table, poised expression

class_Rest.label: Academy Infirmary Lounge
class_Rest.setting: quiet sun-filtered dormitory sitting room with plush armchairs and tea tray
class_Rest.pose: resting peacefully in a cushioned armchair with a cup of tea

job_Hostess.label: Nightfall VIP Hostess
job_Hostess.setting: dim neon-noir VIP lounge booth, crystal champagne glasses, deep indigo velvet seating
job_Hostess.pose: leaning close beside the patron at a candlelit booth, charming smile

job_Bartender.label: Nightfall Cocktail Bar
job_Bartender.setting: backlit mahogany nightclub bar with glowing amber liquor shelves and neon reflections
job_Bartender.pose: pouring a glowing craft cocktail behind the bar, poised gaze

job_Dancer.label: Nightfall Spotlight Stage
job_Dancer.setting: dramatic nightclub stage bathed in indigo and rose spotlights, smoky air
job_Dancer.pose: performing an expressive, sensual dance mid-motion under stage lights

job_Singer.label: Nightfall Vocal Stage
job_Singer.setting: intimate jazz-noir nightclub stage with vintage brass microphone and soft gold rim light
job_Singer.pose: singing close into a classic microphone, eyes half-lidded and captivating

job_Security.label: VIP Floor Security
job_Security.setting: shadowed velvet corridor overlooking the Nightfall VIP gallery, indigo neon accents
job_Security.pose: standing watch with calm authority, sharp observant gaze

job_Private_Service.label: Nightfall Private Suite
job_Private_Service.setting: luxurious private velvet suite with dim warm sconces, silk sheets, and locked double doors
job_Private_Service.pose: attending closely to the patron inside the dimly lit private suite

night_rest.label: Dormitory Rest
night_rest.setting: cozy dark-wood dormitory bedroom lit by soft moonlight and bedside lamp
night_rest.pose: relaxing on silk bedding in the quiet night

night_visit.label: Director's Private Visit
night_visit.setting: shadowy executive study after hours, mahogany desk, fireplace glow, rain on tall windows
night_visit.pose: straddling the edge of the mahogany desk, flushed and looking straight into the viewer's eyes

counseling.label: Targeted Counseling
counseling.setting: quiet executive office with leather armchairs and warm desk lamp
counseling.pose: seated across from the viewer, composed yet attentive

intimate_guidance.label: Intimate Guidance
intimate_guidance.setting: locked executive sanctuary behind heavy curtains, warm amber lamplight, deep shadows
intimate_guidance.pose: drawn close in private submission, breathless expression looking up at the viewer
